div.div: كُحْكُحٌ and كِحْكِحٌ A decrepit old woman: (S, K:) a she-camel far advanced in age: (K:) or old and weak: (S:) or far advanced in age, and having lost her teeth: (T:) a she-camel, and cow, and ewe, or she-goat, old and weak, and unable to retain her slaver: or whose teeth are consumed. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
